label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or political body Y.
scope_notes: Chair, executive, head, chief and equivalent leadership qualify. Founder, owner, partner, generic employment, meetings and nomination alone do not establish tenure; historical office counts.

facts.reason: Repeated chairman-of, head-of and leader-of descriptions clearly connect Yasir Arafat to leadership of the Palestine Liberation Organization.
L. William Seidman is explicitly chairman and head of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation; succession language is compatible with historical tenure.
Chairman, executive and head descriptions establish Michael D. Eisner leading Walt Disney Company; the movie reference is additional mixed evidence.
Executive-of and possessive executive descriptions, including succession into that office, support Jeffrey K. Skilling holding an Enron leadership role.
Raymond D. Horton is described as president, head and chairman of Citizens Budget Commission.
